text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho, mending your dogi, are you? 
A commendable attitude.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I figured if I made the hole, I ought 
to 
sew it up myself—Ow, ouch!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
! Are you all right?! Here, let me see it. 
—I will teach you how to mend it properly 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Trainer. I lost track of time 
while looking after my juniors...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, that is no excuse. 
I swear to repay this debt through my 
actions. 
...Spare no mercy in my next training.
